facts.text: Raffles Makkah Palace is an all-suite hotel overlooking the Holy Kaaba and Masjid Al Haram.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Makkah Palace is an iconic all-suite sanctuary overlooking the Holy Kaaba and Masjid Al Haram

facts.text: Suites are designed in a comfortable residential style with Arabesque accents.
facts.excerpt: Designed in comfortable residential style with Arabesque accents

facts.text: All suites come with 24-hour Raffles Butler Service.
facts.excerpt: all our suites overlook the Grand Mosque and Kaaba and come with 24-hour Raffles Butler Service

facts.text: All suites overlook the Grand Mosque and Kaaba.
facts.excerpt: all our suites overlook the Grand Mosque and Kaaba

facts.text: Select suites offer views of the Holy Kaaba.
facts.excerpt: with select suites offering breathtaking views of the Holy Kaaba

facts.text: The hotel is approximately a 5-minute walk from Al Masjid Al Haram.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Makkah Palace is approximately a 5-minute walk from Al Masjid Al Haram

facts.text: Private elevators within the hotel are exclusively for Raffles Makkah Palace guests.
facts.excerpt: private elevators within the hotel exclusively for Raffles Makkah Palace guests

facts.text: Dedicated elevators within the Clock Towers Complex lead directly to the ground floor.
facts.excerpt: dedicated elevators within the Clock Towers Complex that lead directly to the ground floor

facts.text: The hotel is part of the Abraj Al Bait Complex, alongside a four-storey luxury shopping centre, a prayer hall, a convention centre, a museum and a lunar observatory.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Makkah palace also forms part of the Abraj Al Bait Complex alongside a four-storey luxury shopping centre, a prayer hall for 10,000 people, a convention centre for 1,500, a museum and a lunar observatory

facts.text: The hotel is close to Jabal Al Nour (Mountain of Light), Al Jamarat and Jabal Thawr.
facts.excerpt: The property is also located close to the Jabal Al Nour (Mountain of Light), Al Jamarat and Jabal Thawr.

facts.text: Al Majlis serves Mediterranean cuisines prepared simply, in the classic Italian way.
facts.excerpt: Al Majlis offers a variety of Mediterranean cuisines that are prepared simply, in the classic Italian way.

facts.text: Al Majlis has an outdoor terrace overlooking the Grand Mosque and the Kaaba.
facts.excerpt: or on the outdoor terrace overlooking the Grand Mosque and the Kaaba

facts.text: In-suite dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Our 24-hour service bringing you delicious dishes and drinks whenever the mood takes you.

facts.text: Raffles Spa has female and male spa and gym facilities on the 11th and 12th floors.
facts.excerpt: Award-winning female and male spa and gym facilities on the 11th and 12th floors.

facts.text: The spa has sauna and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt: Sauna & steam rooms

facts.text: Spa treatments are inspired by the three stages of the lotus: bud (body), blossom (beauty) and bloom (holistic experiences).
facts.excerpt: Our treatments are inspired by these three stages of change: bud (body), blossom (beauty) and bloom (holistic experiences).

facts.text: The hotel has a private prayer area.
facts.excerpt: Private prayer area

facts.text: The hotel offers prayer facilities overlooking Al Masjid Al Haram.
facts.excerpt: The hotel also offers exclusive prayer facilities overlooking Al Masjid Al Haram

facts.text: The hotel arranges custom tours to Makkah's historical areas and main religious attractions, including excursions and events for children.
facts.excerpt: Custom tours to Makkah's historical areas and main religious attractions, including specially-arranged excursions and events for children.

facts.text: Return transfers to and from Jeddah's Abdulaziz International Airport can be arranged on request.
facts.excerpt: Return transfers from and to Jeddah's Abdulaziz International Airport can be arranged on request.

facts.text: The Majestic Suite has Kaaba views, two living rooms and a prayer room.
facts.excerpt: featuring stunning Kaaba views, 5 elegant bedrooms with 3 king beds and 2 twin beds, two grand living rooms, a prayer room, and personalized 24-hour Raffles butler service

facts.text: Raffles Butlers are the guests' primary point of contact and know the hotel's services and the local vicinity.
facts.excerpt: They are fully conversant with all services and facilities offered by the hotel and also about the local vicinity.

facts.text: The hotel says the best time to visit is the cooler months, from October to March.
facts.excerpt: The best time to visit is during the cooler months, from October to March

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as the pinnacle of luxury in Makkah.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Makkah Palace stands as the pinnacle of luxury in Makkah

facts.text: The hotel says it was awarded Best All-Suite Hotel and Best Hotel Spa in Saudi Arabia.
facts.excerpt: Awarded as the Best All-Suite Hotel and home to the Best Hotel Spa in Saudi Arabia

contradictions.note: p2 says all suites overlook the Grand Mosque and Kaaba; the same page's FAQ says only select suites offer Kaaba views, and p1 lists a Partial Kaaba View suite
